sentences.text:
Author: Vivek Bharti Sharma
Bench: Vivek Bharti Sharma
 Office Notes, reports,
 orders or proceedings
Sl.
No.
 Date or directions and Court'S Or Judge'S Order
S  Registrar's order with  Signatures  09.05.2025 C-528 No. 579 of 2025  Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Ms. Pushpa Joshi, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Ms. Nispushmola Joshi, learned counsel for petitioner.
2. Mr. Deepak Bisht, learned Deputy A.G. for the State.

3. This petition is filed under Section 528 B.N.S.S. to quash the impugned chargesheet,
summoning/cognizance order dated 04.02.2025 passed in Session Trial No. 22 of 2025 under Sections 376, 504 & 506 I.P.C. by the learned Sessions Judge, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

4. Learned senior counsel for the petitioner/accused submitted that respondent no. 2 lodged an FIR against the petitioner/accused alleging that the petitioner and the respondent no.2/complainant were engaged; that, thereafter, he petitioner/accused committed rape upon the respondent no./2complainant, however, the complainant remained silent at the time, believing that marriage with the petitioner/accused would take place near future.

She further submits that  petitioner/accused and respondent  2/complainant were engaged since 07.03.2022 and remained in continuous contact during this period; that, subsequently, certain disputes arose between them; that, thereafter, the family of respondent no. 2/complainant started demanding money from the petitioner/accused in order to settle the dispute; that, when the petitioner/accused refused to accede to their demand, the present FIR was lodged against him to pressurize him, therefore, entire criminal proceedings against the petitioner/accused is unsustainable and liable to be set aside.
5.

Per contra, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the submission of learned senior counsel,
however, seeks time to file detailed counter affidavit in the matter.

C528/579/2025 on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108930907/
1 6.
Issue notices to respondent no.2 through ordinary process and registered post acknowledgment due as well as through e-mail and whatsapp, if available.

7. Steps to be taken within three weeks.
8.
List this case on 17.07.2025 for hearing on admission.

9. Meanwhile, the effect and operation of impugned summoning/cognizance order dated 04.02.2025 passed in Session Trial No. 22 of 2025 by the learned Sessions Judge, Rudrapur,
District Udham Singh Nagar shall remain stayed till the next date of listing.
10. Learned counsel for the respondents may file counter affidavit in the meantime.

(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 09.05.2025 Mamta C528/579/2025 on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108930907/
2
